title: Rapid modular CAR-T generation with CRISPR/Cpf1 and AAV systems
protocol: Identify genes for knockout by targeted delivery of HDR template.
Design LbCpf1 crRNA \(20bp) using Benchling or other computational pipelines.
Synthesize oligonucleotides with two LbCpf1 direct repeat and sticky ends.
Digest pXD017 with FD BbsI and insert guide after U6 promoter (pXD017-39).
Generate CD22BBz CAR as previously described 11.
Find the sequence of CD19 binding scFv \(FMC63) from NCBI (GenBank: HM852952).
Add Flag-tag sequence \(GATTACAAAGACGATGACGATAAG) after the CD8⍺ leader sequence for detecting CD19BBz CAR.
Synthesize m971-BBz and FMC63-BBz using gBlock (IDT).
Amplify left and right homologous arms of the TRAC or PDCD1 locus from primary CD4+ T cells by PCR using locus-specific primer sets with multiple cloning site \(MCS).
Clone HDR sequences into the AAV vector by Gibson assembly.
Incubate samples in a thermocycler at 50°C for 30 minutes.
Digest pXD040 with BsiWI and Acc65I, and then clone CAR sequences into MCS by Gibson assembly.
Transfect HEK293FT cells with AAV constructs, AAV2 transgene vectors, packaging plasmid, and AAV6/9 serotype plasmid together with polyethyleneimine.
Collect transfected cells with PBS after 72 hours of transfection.
Mix transfected cells with pure chloroform (1/10 volume).
Incubate cells at 37 °C with vigorous shaking for 1 hour.
Add NaCl to a final concentration of 1 M.
Centrifuge at 20,000g at 4 °C for 15 minutes.
Transfer the aqueous layer to another tube and discard the chloroform layer.
Add PEG8000 to the sample until it reaches 10% (w/v) and shake until dissolved.
Incubate the mixture at 4 °C for 1 hour and then centrifuge at 20,000g at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant and suspend the pellet in DPBS with MgCl2.
Treat the sample with universal nuclease and incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes.
Add chloroform (1:1 volume), shake, and centrifuge at 12,000g at 4 °C for 15 minutes.
Isolate the aqueous layer and concentrate it through a 100-kDa MWCO filter.
Aliquot the virus and store at -80 °C.
Prepare cells at a density of 2 x 105 cells per 10 μL tip reaction or 2 x 106 cells per 100 μL tip reaction in electroporation Buffer R.
Mix cells with 1 μg or 10 μg of modified NLS-LbCpf1-NLS mRNA according to reaction volume.
Electric shock cells at program 24 (1,600V, 10ms, and three pulses).
Transfer cells into 200µl or 1mL of pre-warmed X-VIVO media without antibiotics immediately after electroporation.
Add indicated volumes of AAV into the T cells 2-4 hours after electroporation.
Incubate CD22BBz CAR transduced T cells with 0.2 μg CD22-Fc in 100 μL PBS for 30 minutes, and then stain with PE-IgG-Fc and FITC-CD3 antibodies for 30 minutes.
For CD19BBz CAR detection, incubate CD19BBz CAR transduced T cells with APC-anti-DYKDDDDK Tag and FITC-CD3 antibodies for 30 minutes.
Wash cells twice after staining.
Quantify and sort labeled cells on BD FACSAria II.
Analyze the staining patterns using FlowJo software 9.9.4.
Harvest the bulk transduced T cells and sorted T cells five days after electroporation.
Collect genomic DNA from harvested cells using QuickExtract DNA Extraction Solution.
PCR amplify target loci from genomic DNA around cutting site using primers TRAC_suvF and TRAC_suvR.
Run PCR amplicons on a 2% E-gel EX and purify using QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit.
Denature 200 ng of purified PCR product, anneal, and digest with T7E1 at 37°C for 45 minutes.
Load digested PCR products into a 2% E-gel EX and quantify DNA fragment abundance using E-Gel™ Low Range Quantitative DNA Ladder.
Use three primers for In-Out PCR: TRAC 1st, TRAC 2st, and CD22CAR 3rd.
Normalize amplicon concentration by comparison to the product resulting from uninfected control with genomic DNA isolated from human CD4+ T cells.
Prepare PCR products for Nextera library preparation following manufacturer’s protocols (Illumina).
Sequence prepped libraries using 100-bp paired-end reads on an Illumina HiSeq 4000 instrument or equivalent.
Use PCR products from amplification around the cutting site of genomic DNA for Nextera library preparation according to Illumina’s protocols.
Sequence prepped libraries using 100-bp paired-end reads on an Illumina HiSeq 4000 instrument or equivalent.
Map paired reads to amplicon sequences provided in FASTA form using BWA-MEM with the -M option.
Discard 100bp reads in SAM files that fall outside a +/- 75bp window of the expected cut site within the amplicon.
Discard soft-clipped reads identified by the “S” character in CIGAR strings.
Identify indel reads by the presence of "I" or "D" characters within the CIGAR string.
Quantify cutting efficiency as a percentage of indels over total (indel plus wild-type) reads within the defined window.
Map reads to possible amplicons based on primer combinations and HDR status.
Define "informative" amplicons so that 100bp reads would have at least 20bp homology with the CAR sequence or the other TRAC arm in the case of wild-type sequences.
Use informative reads to distinguish wild-type, NHEJ and HDR reads with higher confidence.
Use SAMtools to convert SAM files to BAM.
Sort the BAM files.
Index the sorted BAM files.
Generate summary statistics of read counts with the idxstats option.
Quantify wild-type vs NHEJ reads by taking reads that mapped to “info_nonHDR” sequence.
Call reads with indels within the CIGAR string as NHEJ.
Call remaining reads as wild-type.
Pool read counts for downstream analysis.
Generate lentivirus including GFP-Luciferase reporter genes.
Infect NALM6 cells (ATCC) with 2x concentrated lentivirus by spinoculation in retronectin-coated plates at 800g for 45 minutes at 32°C.
Sort GFP positive cells (NALM6-GL) by flow cytometry after infection for 2 days.
Perform a second round of sorting after culturing for an additional two days.
Incubate cells with 150 μg/ml D-Luciferin and measure bioluminescence signal intensity by an IVIS system to assess luciferase expression.
Seed 2104 NALM6-GL cells in a 96 well plate.
Co-culture modified T cells with NALM6-GL at indicated E:T ratios for 7 days.
Co-culture modified T cells with NALM6-GL at indicated E:T ratios for 24 hours.
Add 150 μg/ml D-Luciferin into each well and measure luciferase assay intensity by a plate reader to assess cell proliferation.
Co-culture T cells modified by AAV with NALM6-GL cells at 0.5:1 E:T ratio for 24 hours.
Collect cells and wash once by DPBS.
Incubate cells with 0.2 μg CD22-Fc in 100 μL DPBS for 30 minutes.
Stain cells with PE-IgG-Fc, PD-1-FITC, TIGIT-APC, and LAG3-Percp/Cy5.5 for 30 minutes.
Measure stained cells by flow cytometry.
After infection for 5 days, co-culture AAV transduced CD22BBz CAR-T cells with NALM6 at 1:1 E:T ratio in fresh media supplemented with brefeldin A and 2 ng/mL IL-2.
Incubate samples for 5 hours.
Collect and stain samples for surface CAR after incubation.
Fix and permeabilize cells using fixation/permeabilization solution (BD).
Add anti-IFNγ-APC or anti-TNF-α-FITC for intracellular staining.
Wash stained cells with BD Perm/Wash™ buffer.
Measure cells by flow cytometry.
